hook: Lula, 80, wins a *4th term* with a record *64 million* votes
tldr: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva beat Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's runoff, with 64 million votes, the most ever in a Brazilian presidential election. He had trailed in round one (45.16% vs 47.03%). 'Brazil is nobody's backyard,' he said, pointing at alleged US meddling.

beats.what: Lula won by more than 4 million votes after a comeback driven by young voters' rallies.
beats.why: Young Brazilians feared cuts to public education, health and transport under Bolsonaro.
beats.care: Brazil is India's BRICS partner; Lula promises a national AI system and more public universities.
